tools.description: Reads the kit-outline.md blueprint — returns the design of the kit's 6 parts, build order, and Gate 0-3 kill criteria. Not the kit itself, only the blueprint.
tools.name: kit_outline_read

part.description: One of the 6 parts (reminder-cadence-pack, same-day-rebooking, waitlist-fill-sop, no-show-log-tracker, deposit-policy-template, front-desk-quick-card) or empty = the whole blueprint

tools.description: Reads pain, price, rails, and gate information from the research report (digital-product-final-20261112) — no-show ~11% (AAHA), ~$200 avg visit, $49 price inference, Lemon Squeezy/Polar/Gumroad rails.
tools.name: research_notes

section.description: A section of the report (e.g. pain, price, rails, gates, revenue) or empty = summary

tools.description: Writes a DRAFT of an email to send to a vet clinic (kit launch email, per the 25/day plan). DRAFT only — does not send. Sending needs Boss's send gate word, and the email channel is now PAUSED.
tools.name: draft_email

tools.description: Writes a DRAFT caption for a kit launch/sales post (Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn). DRAFT only — does not publish.
tools.name: draft_caption

topic.description: The post's topic (e.g. no-show pain, kit launch)

tools.description: Reads the engine's true status — Gate 0 (from gate0-status.md), PA list 39/100, sale 0, the kit's 6 parts' status. Invents no numbers.
tools.name: status_read

tools.description: Writes a DRAFT of a script inside the kit (reminder call script, rebooking script, waitlist call script) — plain US English, with [NAME]/[PET]/[TIME] fields. DRAFT only, to be built after Gate 0.
tools.name: draft_script

script_type.description: The script type: reminder-t72h, reminder-t24h, reminder-t2h, rebooking, waitlist

tools.description: Returns a DRAFT of the kit launch checklist (like the Chief's launch_prep — Gate 0, 6 kit parts, Gate 1, listings, sales page, 25/day mail plan), launch_blocked: true. DRAFT only — does not launch.
tools.name: launch_kit

confirm_gate0.description: Whether Gate 0 has PASSED — false means blocked-gate0

tools.description: Records a kit sale (Lemon Squeezy/Gumroad sale). BLOCKED — Gate 0 NOT PASSED, sale 0, no sale is recorded. Gated: spend.
tools.name: sell_kit

amount_usd.description: Sale amount USD — locked price $49 (launch $39 for the first 30 buyers)

buyer.description: The buyer clinic's name (only if there is a real sale)
